capabilities: convert PDFs to Markdown with OCR, formulas and tables
extract and save images from PDFs into the vault
batch-convert multiple PDFs from the file explorer or command palette
choose between self-hosted Marker endpoints and cloud OCR APIs
optionally reformat extracted Markdown with CLI agents like Claude or Codex
disambiguation: Not a plain text extractor: it produces formatted Markdown notes with images, tables, math and optional agent-based cleanup, not just recognized text.
extras: Warns that MistralAI and Mathpix upload documents to their servers (Mistral stores files at least 24h); CLI formatting is desktop-only and the README stresses output checks are not guaranteed semantic equivalence; API keys are stored in Obsidian's secret storage rather than data.json.
motivation: The author wanted superior extraction quality and mobile accessibility compared to other converters, working directly inside Obsidian via external AI endpoints.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn PDFs—especially scanned or math-heavy ones—into editable Markdown notes with images, tables and formulas intact.

relations.evidence: Marker Project: The AI model powering the conversions
MistralAI (OCR API with excellent results, billed per page)
Mathpix (OCR API specialized in math and science, also converts DOCX, PPTX, EPUB and other formats)
datalab.to (Hosted API for the Marker AI model, provided by the developer himself)
Any OpenAI compatible API, e.g. OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama or LM Studio

requires.name: MistralAI, Mathpix, Datalab or OpenAI-compatible API key
datalab.to account or Mathpix credits for hosted endpoints
self-hosted Marker API (Docker or Python) or local Ollama/LM Studio server

summary: Converts PDFs to Markdown with OCR, formulas, tables and images, using Marker, datalab.to, MistralAI, Mathpix, or any OpenAI-compatible API.
